name: Doggy
backstory: Doggy is a unique Construct in the Shadow-Cursed Lands in the service of the curse-bound child Oliver. Despite appearing as a Shadow and having similar abilities to a Shadow Mastiff, it is a construct, not an undead or a monstrosity.
